giveaways.title: Win 1 of 3 Aurora Peptides prizes
giveaways.description: Orders over $100 after discount code and tax placed between August 1 and August 3 are entered automatically. Code SAMMYC must be used on the order to be entered. Three prizes are drawn: $100 store credit, a 4 count vial case loaded by Aurora Peptides, and a second $100 store credit. Winners are emailed on August 4.
giveaways.prize: $100 credit, loaded 4 count vial case, $100 credit

giveaways.title: Win $1,000 in Coffee and Peppers store credit
giveaways.description: Every $100 spent during the Coffee and Peppers 1 Year Anniversary Sale earns one entry into a draw for $1,000 in store credit. The sale runs from August 14 through August 16 and entries accumulate across all three days. Entry terms and the draw are handled by the vendor.
